title: Project Startup Guide
summary: A starter kit and interactive dashboard for students and non-engineers beginning a project with AI assistance: four documents written before any code, a human review gate, then build.

narrative.problem: Most first projects die the same way: someone asks an AI to build an app, gets 800 lines back, and spends three weeks discovering nobody agreed on what the app was.
narrative.decision: Puts four short Markdown documents (concept, specification, plan and backlog) in front of the code; each is drafted with an AI assistant, rewritten by the student and approved by a human reviewer against a checklist before work moves on.
narrative.tradeoff: Building starts later, and every phase depends on a second person being available to review; a learner without a reviewer cannot pass the gate as designed.
narrative.limitation: Pricing, free tiers, student benefits and MCP server addresses change and were checked only when written, and the method assumes VS Code Copilot Chat in Agent mode for most of the work.
